description: This file contains unit test fixture implementations for the SharedMemoryBuffer component in the Rialto media server, including setup, mapping/unmapping partitions, retrieving data lengths and offsets, clearing data, and accessing buffer pointers.

classes.name: SharedMemoryBufferTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for SharedMemoryBuffer unit tests, providing setup and utility methods for testing buffer operations.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the shared memory buffer with specified maximum playbacks and web audio players.

methods.name: mapPartitionShouldSucceed
methods.description: Tests that mapping a partition succeeds for given playback type and ID.

methods.name: mapPartitionShouldFail
methods.description: Tests that mapping a partition fails for given playback type and ID.

methods.name: unmapPartitionShouldSucceed
methods.description: Tests that unmapping a partition succeeds for given playback type and ID.

methods.name: unmapPartitionShouldFail
methods.description: Tests that unmapping a partition fails for given playback type and ID.

methods.name: shouldReturnMaxGenericAudioDataLen
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of maximum data length for generic audio buffers.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnMaxAudioDataLen
methods.description: Verifies that requesting max data length for unsupported playback type returns 0.

methods.name: shouldReturnMaxGenericVideoDataLen
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of maximum data length for generic video buffers.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnMaxVideoDataLen
methods.description: Verifies that requesting max data length for unsupported playback type returns 0.

methods.name: shouldReturnMaxWebAudioDataLen
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of maximum data length for web audio buffers.

methods.name: shouldReturnVideoDataOffset
methods.description: Checks correct data offset retrieval for video data.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnVideoDataOffset
methods.description: Ensures exception is thrown when retrieving video data offset for invalid playback type.

methods.name: shouldReturnAudioDataOffset
methods.description: Checks correct data offset retrieval for audio data.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnAudioDataOffset
methods.description: Ensures exception is thrown when retrieving audio data offset for invalid playback type.

methods.name: shouldClearAudioData
methods.description: Verifies clearing of audio data succeeds.

methods.name: shouldFailToClearAudioData
methods.description: Verifies clearing of audio data fails for invalid conditions.

methods.name: shouldClearVideoData
methods.description: Verifies clearing of video data succeeds.

methods.name: shouldFailToClearVideoData
methods.description: Verifies clearing of video data fails for invalid conditions.

methods.name: shouldGetDataPtr
methods.description: Retrieves pointer to data for given playback type, ID, and media source type.

methods.name: shouldFailToGetDataPtr
methods.description: Ensures nullptr is returned when data pointer cannot be retrieved.

methods.name: shouldGetFd
methods.description: Checks that the file descriptor for the shared memory buffer is valid.

methods.name: shouldGetSize
methods.description: Verifies total size of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: shouldGetBuffer
methods.description: Checks that the buffer pointer is valid.
